info.description: Backend API for WBD K03-03 — database management platform with user/group access control and migration support.
info.title: WBD K03-03 API

get.description: Returns a paginated list of all databases. Requires admin privileges.

post.description: Registers a new database connection. Requires admin privileges.

get.description: Returns a database by its ID. Requires admin privileges.

delete.description: Deletes a registered database by its ID. Requires admin privileges.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of all groups. Requires admin privileges.

post.description: Creates a new group with database access permissions. Requires admin privileges.

400.description: Invalid input or invalid database access type

get.description: Returns a single group by its ID. Requires admin privileges.

delete.description: Deletes a group by its ID. Requires admin privileges.

409.description: Group still has users / must have database

patch.description: Updates an existing group. Requires admin privileges.

post.description: Adds an existing user to an existing group. Requires admin privileges.

delete.description: Removes an existing user from an existing group. Requires admin privileges.

409.description: Membership not found / user must remain in a group

get.description: Returns a paginated list of all users. Requires admin privileges.

post.description: Creates a new user and assigns them to one or more groups. Requires admin privileges.

get.description: Returns a single user by their ID. Requires admin privileges.

delete.description: Deletes a user by their ID. Requires admin privileges.

409.description: User must have at least one group

patch.description: Updates an existing user's username and/or password. Requires admin privileges.
Updates the role of a user (e.g. "admin" or "user"). Requires admin privileges.

post.description: Authenticate user with username and password. On success, a session cookie is set.
Invalidate the current session. Clears the session cookie.

get.description: Returns details of the currently authenticated user based on session cookie.
Check server health status and system database connectivity.
Returns a paginated list of databases the authenticated user has access to.

post.description: Rolls back all migrations up to and including the target migration ID.

get.description: Returns a specific database that the authenticated user has view access to.

post.description: Returns the execution plan for a SQL query. Requires view access. Use `analyzer=true` for EXPLAIN ANALYZE.

400.description: Invalid database ID, query, or analyzer param

get.description: Returns a paginated list of migrations for a specific database. Requires view access.

post.description: Runs a SQL migration (sql_up) on the specified database and records the result. Requires edit access.

400.description: Invalid database ID or migration input

get.description: Compares the sql_up and sql_down of two migrations within a database. Requires view access.

400.description: Invalid database ID or migration IDs

get.description: Returns a specific migration by its ID within a database. Requires view access.

post.description: Executes a raw SQL query on the specified database. Requires view access.

CookieAuth.description: Session cookie. After login, copy the value of the `session` cookie from the Set-Cookie header and paste it here as: `session=<token>`
CookieAuth.name: Cookie
